description: Supporter is the Name of badge; adult refers to Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65

intent: What is the name of user with the ID of 30?

intent: How many users were from New York?

intent: How many votes were made in 2010?

intent: How many users were adult?

intent: Calculate the ratio of votes in 2010 and 2011.
description: DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010), COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011)) FROM votes;
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011', 1, 0)) FROM votes

intent: How many posts were created by Daniel Vassallo?
description: DisplayName = 'Daniel Vassallo';

intent: How many votes were made by Harlan?
description: DisplayName = 'Harlan';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN votes AS T3 ON T3.PostId = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harlan'

intent: Which post by slashnick has the most answers count? State the post ID.
description: most answers count refers to MAX(AnswerCount); post by slashnick refers to DisplayName = 'slashnick';

intent: Among posts by Harvey Motulsky and Noah Snyder, which one has higher popularity?
description: Has higher popularity means the post has higher view count ; calculation = MAX(SUM(ViewCount)) where DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder';
source_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR T1.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder' GROUP BY T1.DisplayName ORDER BY SUM(T3.ViewCount) DESC LIMIT 1

intent: How many posts by Matt Parker have more than 4 votes?
description: more than 4 votes refer to PostId > 4; DisplayName = 'Matt Parker';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id INNER JOIN votes AS T4 ON T4.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Matt Parker' GROUP BY T2.PostId, T4.Id HAVING COUNT(T4.Id) > 4

intent: How many negative comments did Neil McGuigan get in his posts?
description: Negative comment refers to score < 60; DisplayName = 'Neil McGuigan';
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T3.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Neil McGuigan' AND T3.Score < 60

intent: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
description: used by Mark Meckes refers to DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'; Doen't have comments refers to CommentCount = 0;
source_sql: SELECT T3.Tags FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND T3.CommentCount = 0

intent: List all the name of users that obtained the Organizer Badges.
description: name of users refers to DisplayName; the Organizer Badges refer to badges where Name = 'Organizer';
source_sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.`Name` = 'Organizer'

intent: Based on posts posted by Community, calculate the percentage of posts that use the R language.
description: DIVIDE(COUNT(PostId WHERE TagName = 'r')), (COUNT(PostId WHERE DisplayName = 'Community')) as percentage; R language refers to tagname = 'r'
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T3.TagName = 'r', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN tags AS T3 ON T3.ExcerptPostId = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Community'

intent: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
description: calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Mornington'), SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Amos'));
source_sql: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Mornington', T3.ViewCount, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Amos', T3.ViewCount, 0)) AS diff FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId

intent: How many users received commentator badges in 2014?

intent: How many posts were created on 21st July, 2010?

description: total views refer to ViewCount; Name the user refers to DisplayName; post 'Computer Game Datasets' refers to Text = 'Computer Game Datasets';

intent: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
description: The higher reputation the user has the more influence; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(stats_posts.Id where Score > 50 and MAX(Reputation))), COUNT(stats_posts.Id where MAX(Reputation));
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users T1 INNER JOIN posts T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users ) T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation

source_sql: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN ( SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150 ) ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1

intent: List the creation date and age of the user that commented with webiste.
description: commented with webiste refers to the value contains 'http://'
source_sql: SELECT T2.CreationDate, T2.Age FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.text LIKE '%http://%'

intent: In comments with 0 score, how many of the posts have view count lower than 5?
description: view count lower than 5 refers to ViewCount < 5;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.ViewCount < 5 AND T2.Score = 0

intent: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
description: in posts with 1 comment refers to CommentCount = 1;
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T2.Score = 0

intent: Among products comments with 0 score, what is the total number of users ages 40 years old?
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score = 0 AND T2.Age = 40

intent: What is the post ID and the comments commented in the post titled by "Group differences on a five point Likert item"?
description: Title = 'Group differences on a five point Likert item';
source_sql: SELECT T2.Id, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Title = 'Group differences on a five point Likert item'

intent: What is the up vote number of the user that commented "R is also lazy evaluated."?
description: commented "R is also lazy evaluated." refers to Text of the comment;
source_sql: SELECT T2.UpVotes FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'R is also lazy evaluated.'

intent: List the comments commented by the user with a username of Harvey Motulsky.
description: comments refer to Text; username of Harvey Motulsky refers to DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky';
source_sql: SELECT T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'

intent: In comments with score between 1 to 5, list down the display names of the users with 0 down votes.
description: DownVotes = 0; Score BETWEEN 1 and 5
source_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND T2.DownVotes = 0

intent: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
description: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(UserId where UpVotes = 0 and Score BETWEEN 5 and 10))*100, (COUNT(UserId where Score BETWEEN 5 and 10));
source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.UpVotes = 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100/ COUNT(T1.Id) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
